# DAB Climbing

> DAB is a New York climbing brand making considered training tools for warm-ups, weighted pulls, and finger-strength work.

DAB's first collection consists of customizable no-hang climbing blocks. Products are sold in USD through the official website. Product pages are the authoritative source for current prices, available colors, edge depths, shipping, and returns.

## Products

- [DAB BLOCK 02](https://www.dabclimbing.com/buy/block-02/): An ergonomic uneven-edge no-hang training block with a variable-height profile designed for natural finger positioning and balanced loading.
- [DAB BLOCK 01](https://www.dabclimbing.com/buy/block-01/): A flat-edge no-hang training block for hold-specific practice, with customizable edge depths.

## Important product note

DAB BLOCK products are training tools. They are not certified life-safety equipment. Refer to the product page for the current load disclaimer and usage details.
